description: Diagnoses a sales problem of the buyer's team: likely causes, what the product does for each with the page proving it, and the pages to quote (sector page first). Use it when the buyer describes their problem or asks how the product would help their company: we lose to cheaper rivals, clients haggle over our fees, prospects go silent. Pass secteur when known. For selling advice without the product, use conseils. Returns summaries: read a page with lire_page for details.

langue.description: Language of the buyer's question (en, fr, es): always pass it, the pages and answers are in this language.

secteur.description: Sector of the buyer, when known (agences, conseil, esn, saas).

symptome.description: The problem in the buyer's words (e.g. our prospects stop replying after the proposal).

name: resoudre_probleme
title: Solve a sales problem
